stdout:
Set comment moderation status. Use this tool to set comment moderation status.

Usage:
  yutu comment setModerationStatus [flags]

Examples:
# Publish a held comment
yutu comment setModerationStatus --ids abc123 --moderationStatus published
# Hold multiple comments for review
yutu comment setModerationStatus --ids abc123,def456 --moderationStatus heldForReview
# Reject a comment and ban author
yutu comment setModerationStatus --ids abc123 --moderationStatus rejected --banAuthor

Flags:
  -A, --banAuthor                 If set to true the author of the comment gets added to the ban list
  -h, --help                      help for setModerationStatus
  -i, --ids strings               IDs of comments
  -s, --moderationStatus string   heldForReview|published|rejected
  -o, --output string             json|yaml|silent
      --yes                       Confirm the operation
